name: Perceval
description: Perceval is an open-source Python framework for programming photonic quantum computers, developed by Quandela. It provides tools for composing circuits from linear optical components, defining single-photon sources, manipulating Fock states, and running simulations on classical backends or Quandela cloud QPUs.
